about_the_game:
Very Disco, Disco Very!

In zero-G, every push is eternal — so keep the groove in motion.

Very Disco, Disco Very! is a chaotic alien disco boardgame for 1–8 players, where rhythm meets rivalry and every shove fuels the groove.
Push, bump, and boogie to fill your Boogie Meter, unlock mystery boxes, and unleash game-changing effects across the dance floor.

Every disco tile you land on builds your color sequence combos, letting you draw from the 3S Card System:

Social Cards: Sharing = caring.
Selfish Cards: Power yourself up.
Sadistic Cards: Sabotage rivals.

Three Phases of Party Chaos

Phase 1 — Collect & Groove

Strut across glowing tiles, match color sequences, and grab items before the beat drops.
It’s all rhythm and shine… until the floor starts moving beneath your feet.

Phase 2 — Boundaries Off, Physics On

The edges dissolve into space — one wrong push and you’re gone.
Every step, every bump, and every dance move carries real consequences.

Phase 3 — Disco Beam Madness

The beat peaks. Beams of light sweep the floor in a cosmic showdown.
When the music stops, you’d better be in the right beam — or you’re out.
It’s musical chairs meets laser tag in zero-G chaos.

Features

🪩 1–8 Players: Local or online alien party madness.
🚀 Disco Board Battles: Once you’re moving, you’re really moving.
🎚️ Boogie Meter System: Stay in rhythm to earn mystery boxes and trigger disco powers.
🧩 Custom Levels: Build your own arenas and absurd layouts.
💣 3S Card System: Social, Selfish, and Sadistic cards that twist the rules.
🎶 Dynamic “Disco Time”: A total rhythmic meltdown.
🌠 Social Disco Stats: Track your pushes, combos, eliminations, and groove rank.
💻 Online Multiplayer: Fast, lightweight, peer-to-peer chaos — no waiting, just instant party energy.
🕺 Fast-Paced Turns: Hesitate, and the groove leaves you behind. The party waits for no one.

Wishlist It, Baby

Prepare for the most absurd alien disco boardgame in the galaxy —
where dancing is mandatory, gravity is optional,
the beat never stops, and even space can’t escape the groove.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible

  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
